notes.title: Update announcement!
notes.content:
[b]Update announcement![/b]

Hello clicker mania.
We are planning to update "Magical Girl Clicker".

New fever mode.
New HENTAI animation.
New items and upgrades.
Item Level up.
All ages mode.
Steam achievements.

The update lets you click longer and more often than ever before.
You did it! Bravo!

Updates are free.
Thank you for always.

An update is currently in development.
Please wait a little longer!
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41371388/7ddd48a57fa312841196995126a152e543ca1ca4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: System Update!
notes.content:
Hi! Gamers!
Updated the game right away.

1: System can be set.
Now you can set the volume and buttons!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35375532/0b1b279219ebd09bb6441d60aedba139e16720e3.png[/img]

2: Released the Japanese version.
The Japanese version was released because the technical problem was solved.
I think it's possible to use the language of your steam, so English users can play in English and Japanese users can play in Japanese.
See Steam help for language switching!

https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=8487-WSCN-4121&l=english
